main_body: stack of three small powder kegs
top_band: none (row 2 on the top keg and row 7 on the bottom kegs are only 1px dark brown outline rows, followed directly by the vertical side/front staves and red bands)
evidence: Each of the three kegs is drawn as a pure front elevation rectangle (4x4 interior pixels of vertical wood staves and horizontal red bands) surrounded by a 1px dark brown outline. Neither the top keg (rows 2-6) nor the bottom two kegs (rows 7-12) show an elliptical top cap seen from above.

style.evidence: The kegs use a dark brown material-toned outline and 4 steps on the wood ramp plus 2 on the red bands, which is clean for a tiny 12x11 cluster, though simple and repetitive across all three identical 4x4 keg faces compared to the rich reference props.
